title: Experiment I original-table cell semantics, certainty classes and reconstruction restrictions

source_references.source: Henry Cavendish, Experiments to Determine the Density of the Earth (1798)
source_references.role: method for point of rest and middle-vibration time

clock_policy.experiment_i_rule: Values printed with hour 0 after the 11:06 event are normalized to hour 12 of the same chronological sequence.

semantic_classes.confirmed: Directly printed observation/value with unambiguous role.
semantic_classes.confirmed_event_time: Printed mass-position event and clock; continuity outside the event is not implied.
semantic_classes.confirmed_value_order_only: Printed value and row order are certain; clock placement is not.
semantic_classes.confirmed_printed_calculation: Printed calculated value with documented calculation role.
semantic_classes.confirmed_printed_result_formula_unresol: Printed result is certain, but the exact local arithmetic path is not stated.
semantic_classes.confirmed_printed_summary_formula_unreso: Printed summary is certain; do not invent its formula.
semantic_classes.confirmed_printed_summary_calculation: Printed summary and its calculation relation are confirmed.

allowed_reconstructions.permission: Plot the three direct division/time pairs at 09:42, 09:55 and 10:05. Any line between them must be labelled interpolation, not observed motion.
Plot each division crossing at its normalized same-day clock time as a direct observation.
Show the four printed middle-vibration times as calculated phase markers, with midpoint divisions derived only through the documented method.
Show extrema on an ordinal sequence axis or in the source table without assigning clock times.
A continuous model may be shown only as a separately named simulation layer with explicit parameters and no historical-time claim.

prohibited_reconstructions.region: 10:05 event to first listed positive extreme
prohibited_reconstructions.reason: The first physical extremity was not observed and the protective intervention times are not recorded.
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: gap, uncertainty band, or separately labelled non-historical simulation

prohibited_reconstructions.reason: Only values and table order are known; Cavendish did not observe vibration time in this phase.
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: ordinal sequence or untimed markers outside the historical clock axis

prohibited_reconstructions.reason: The source describes a temporary return to midway and a later re-advance to positive, without times.
prohibited: claim that masses stayed positive continuously
two-event-only motion presented as complete history
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: known event markers plus an explicitly unresolved intervention interval

prohibited_reconstructions.reason: A like protective method was used after return; the first physical extremity was not observed and intervention times are absent.
prohibited: assigning the listed extreme 5 an exact time
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: gap or unresolved interval before direct timed crossings

prohibited_reconstructions.reason: Extreme values have no printed clocks. Middle-vibration times are calculated phase markers, not extreme times.
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: ordinal extrema sequence; use timed division crossings separately

prohibited_reconstructions.region: Time of middle of vibration column
prohibited_reconstructions.reason: The printed time refers to the midpoint of each vibration, computed from adjacent extrema and crossing times; it is not the Point of rest column.
prohibited: assign point-of-rest y value at middle-vibration time
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: calculated phase-time marker with its own method provenance

prohibited_reconstructions.reason: Source values and rounding must remain as printed even when application arithmetic gives extra digits.
prohibited: overwriting raw data with derived values
prohibited_reconstructions.required_representation: retain raw source and store verification calculations separately

compatibility_replay_conflicts.current_behavior: Positive extrema are assigned equal model spacing between 10:05 and 11:06.
Return extrema are assigned model times from middle-vibration timing and printed Differences.
A continuous compatibility curve is drawn through regions whose historical motion is unresolved.
Only the 10:05 and 11:06 events are animated, implying continuous position states and omitting the protective interventions.
